rater: Implementing assistant; exploratory, not independent human evaluation

rubric.coherence: 1 disconnected or contradictory events/characters; 2 weak local thread with substantial drift; 3 plausible connected sequence; 4 clear consistent narrative; 5 strong narrative continuity.
rubric.fluency: 1 mostly broken syntax or invented words; 2 some fluent clauses with frequent grammar failures; 3 generally readable with occasional errors; 4 consistently fluent; 5 polished prose.
rubric.relevance: 1 abandons prompt; 2 retains a name or broad story setting; 3 develops the starting scene loosely; 4 clearly continues the prompt; 5 closely sustains its specific details.

usefulness: Whole continuation readable and logically connected to the starting scene; isolated good sentences do not qualify.
